# a received thick volume's refreservation is charged to its parent (dd_used):
# the parent's quota cannot go below it, and a second thick volume does not fit
# covers: received
zfs create -o quota=104857600 $R/g
zfs create -V 67108864 $R/v
zfs snapshot $R/v@s1
@sendrecv $R/v@s1 $R/g/r
zfs set quota=10485760 $R/g
zfs create -V 67108864 $R/g/w
